<parameter=code>
r = action(['RIGHT'])
print({k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
def snap(f):
    d = {}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        d.setdefault(n['color'], []).append((n['id'], n['pixels'], (r0,c0,r1,c1)))
    return d
a = snap(previous_frame); b = snap(current_frame)
for k in sorted(set(a)|set(b)):
    if a.get(k) != b.get(k):
        print('CHANGED', k, a.get(k), '->', b.get(k))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
